hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a saturating x2*x5 interaction whose sign determines the residual: positive when x2 and x5 agree in sign, negative when they disagree.
rationale: Every row obeys sign(residual) = sign(x2*x5): rows 0,1,2,3,4,6,8 have negative products (-0.44 to -3.1) with residuals of -0.21 to -0.215, and rows 5,7,9 have positive products (+0.64 to +1.26) with residuals of about +0.21. The constant residual magnitude across very different product sizes points to a bounded, sign-like interaction.
